topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I stumbled upon a weathered box in the garden, buried just beneath the sod. It wasn’t just any box; it was a time capsule, its metal edges now tarnished by the passage of years. Inside, I found old letters, some faded photos, and a small, worn-out music box that no longer plays. The notes inside the letters were from a young couple, talking about their dreams and the future they planned to build. I don’t remember planting this capsule, but somehow, it feels like part of a story I used to know. The world around me seems a little quieter now, as if the capsule carried a piece of the past that was meant to stay hidden.
